banner.title: Cookies and your privacy
banner.body: We use a small set of essential cookies to keep you signed in. Analytics and marketing cookies stay off until you say otherwise.

configure.title: Cookie preferences
configure.body: Toggle the categories you're comfortable with. Essential cookies stay on because the app can't sign you in without them. You can change this any time from settings.

essential.title: Essential
essential.body: Authentication, CSRF tokens, language preference. Always on — the app cannot function without these.

analytics.title: Analytics
